svg.text: Final target architecture • M5 learning deployment shown separately from the production reference
1 task; ECS selects AZ • public IPv4 • egress TCP 443 via IGW • inbound TCP 8080 from ALB SG only
RDS subnet group placement • no NAT route
Public route: 0.0.0.0/0 → IGW • no NAT Gateway in the M5 learning deployment
IAM-authenticated Cloud Run + HTTPS event delivery across cloud boundary.
Fraud decision callback; authenticated and asynchronous
WIF for AWS → GCP; Google-signed OIDC for Pub/Sub → AWS
eventId • correlationId • schemaVersion • trace context; GCP never writes to AWS transactional DBs
DEPLOYMENT PROFILES • M5 LEARNING IS A COST-AWARE PORTFOLIO CHOICE
2 public subnets • 1 ECS task (ECS selects AZ) • public IPv4 • no NAT • IGW egress / TCP 443
ALB HTTP 80 • task ingress TCP 8080 from ALB SG only • RDS Single-AZ db.t4g.micro
Backup 1 day • deletion protection off • skip final snapshot on destroy • logs 7 days
Private ECS subnets across ≥2 AZs • desired count ≥2 • no public IP • NAT per AZ or evaluated endpoints
API Gateway/VPC Link → internal ALB HTTPS 443 + ACM • HTTP redirect • RDS HA/sizing by RTO/RPO
Test restore • deletion protection on • named/retained final snapshot • backup/log retention by policy
Security note: M5 task public IPv4 is for controlled outbound connectivity; the Application SG blocks Internet ingress. This is not presented as production-grade Internet security.
Dashed event and production-reference paths are planned. M5 currently implements the AWS workload path through ALB → ECS/Fargate → PostgreSQL.
